d: Charlie romances Alan's sweet receptionist (guest star KELLY STABLES) as Alan anxiously awaits disaster.
The guys bump into Jake's former teacher (guest star ALICIA WITT) who became a stripper after a fling with Charlie. Charlie tries to help her out, but things spiral out of control.
When Judith (series star MARIN HINKLE) kicks Herb (recurring star RYAN STILES) to the curb, Alan comes knocking.
Alan tries to escape Judith's grasp as Charlie and Herb go on the prowl.
Charlie's new girlfriend, Chelsea (guest star JENNIFER TAYLOR), asks him to spend the night at her place, while Alan tries to enforce a punishment on Jake.
Jake disappears with the daughter of Charlie's neighbor, a former NFL player (guest star MICHAEL CLARKE DUNCAN), and Charlie is left to cover his back.

d: Evelyn offers to pay for Jake's college education, leaving Alan to wonder if he ever needs to work again.
Charlie Sheen's brother, EMILIO ESTEVEZ, and JAMES EARL JONES guest star in an episode where Charlie reevaluates his reckless lifestyle when one of his friends dies.
Charlie and Jake fight for the affections of a waitress (guest star EMILY ROSE), while Alan fights sexual tension with his receptionist, Melissa (guest star KELLY STABLES).
Judith is pregnant with a baby girl and Alan is convinced that he is the father. Meanwhile, Jake is in a contentious mood and Charlie thinks he knows why.

The Butlers and Johnsons are rattled in different ways after an earthquake strikes,with Calvin and Tina moving in with Malcolm and Marty while their home is repaired,and Dave going to extremes trying to prepare his family for the next time.
When there's a break-in at Calvin's business, he teams up with Dave for a stakeout to catch the culprit in the act. Also, Gemma is uncharacteristically reluctant to share her new hobby with Tina.

st: Welcome to the Big Little Leagues
d: Calvin and Malcolm butt heads on coaching styles as Malcolm's little league team approaches its first game of the season. Also, Tina tries to win over a food critic she inadvertently offended before he reviews her cupcakes.

After months of crashing with Malcolm and Marty, Calvin and Tina finally reveal the impressive results of their major home renovation.  Also, Dave and Gemma decide it's time to have "the talk" with Grover.

When Calvin discovers his friend, Lorenzo, (Bill Bellamy), is harboring a secret, he struggles with whether to share the info with Tina. Also, Dave becomes concerned about Gemmas growing closeness to a coach at her school.

st: Welcome to Bro Money, Bro Problems
d: Calvin's wealthy and impulsive brother Curtis makes a surprise visit, creating chaos in the Butlers' lives. Also, Dave and Gemma run into challenges while trying to declutter their home.

When Dave's job requires him to mediate a feud between two wealthy brothers, Calvin tries to help but winds up complicating the process; Gemma turns to Tina for assistance in navigating Grover's first crush.

Calvin and Tina offer to throw a quinceañera for Yoli (Alycia Pascual-Pena), a teen Calvin is mentoring at his auto shop. Also, Dave and Gemma introduce Malcolm to a college baseball coach who has the potential to change his future.
When Calvin is honored by the Chamber of Commerce for the positive impact his business has had on the community, he hopes to finally gain the approval of his mother, Marilyn.
When Tina reunites with her former girl group after decades apart, old issues are reignited, threatening to derail the trio's big performance.

As Marty prepares to propose to his girlfriend, Calvin and Tina work with party planner Chika (Gina Yashere) to throw a celebration that properly honors their future daughter-in-law's Nigerian heritage.
When Dave decides to disconnect the Johnson home from the grid, he inadvertently causes a community-wide power outage, much to Calvin's frustration on the fifth season premiere.

Doug and Carrie want to conceive but receive another negative pregnancy result. When it is revealed that Carrie only has one working ovary, they find that they must get started in conceiving right away, only to be hindered when Doug's parents visit.
Carrie grows jealous when Spence's girlfriend recruits Doug to test her culinary work. Meanwhile, Arthur's lack of classical movie knowledge shocks Carrie.
Now that Deacon and Kelly have separated, Doug makes it his mission to get his friend out of the funk he's been in by taking him out to the clubs.
Doug and Carrie find an old wedding gift.
Doug and Carrie get free tickets to her firm's annual golf outing at a private club.
Doug starts to dream more seriously about running his sandwich shop now that his Uncle Stu (guest star Gavin MacLeod) has generously offered him a large sum of money to see him realize his dream.
While Carrie is away on a business trip, Doug plays host to his parents and seems to re-live his youth while doing it.
Carrie starts Doug on another new diet which makes him miserable.
Carrie and Doug begin preparing for tax time and realize that their charitable giving leaves a little to be desired.
